statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitor) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-50
The denial is based on the service not being deemed medically necessary according to current coverage guidelines and clinical criteria
The 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
The 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology
